actions.name: Recall
actions.description:
Using the method of their choosing, the user takes a creature from their Team out of combat.

In @Trait[conventional] settings creatures are stored and released from @Trait[ball]s. Creatures can be recalled by:

  • Being hit with their Ball via Fling (this Fling is freely done as part of this Action)
  • Being touched with their Ball
  • Being hit by the Ball’s "recall emitter" laser, which can be used on a creature within the Ball’s line of sight
